description: Orders received by EDI, the reseller platform, and the sales desk; pricing, credit check, allocation, and release to the warehouse (about 41,000 order lines per shipping day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $19.2 million of revenue per shipping day passes through the ERP; resellers can buy the same products from competing distributors, so orders not captured within a shipping day are often lost; order data changes every few seconds
manual_workaround: Sales desk takes priority orders on spreadsheets from printed price files; EDI and API orders queue at the VAN and platform for later load
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; primary and secondary VAN; ERP software vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Sales desk (about 400 staff); order management team
quantified_impact_basis: About 60% of a day of gross profit lost to competitors ($0.82 million) plus about $0.28 million overtime and back-entry; revenue at risk $19.2 million per shipping day
acquisition_dependency: AQ-1 orders run on the legacy ERP (BP-17)
single_points_of_failure: ERP central instance (single production instance with second-region standby)

description: Wave planning, picking, packing, and shipping at 6 distribution centers (about 26,000 shipments per shipping day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Carrier cutoffs each afternoon; WMS edge servers sustain picking for up to 8 hours; worker safety on automated lines during abnormal operation
manual_workaround: WMS edge servers continue from cached waves for up to 8 hours; paper pick lists for priority orders; manual sortation at reduced speed
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; handheld and mobile device management vendor; OT integrators; parcel carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 5,900 distribution staff and up to 1,500 temporary workers; 6 distribution centers
quantified_impact_basis: Unshipped orders past carrier cutoffs: about $0.85 million lost gross profit, $0.30 million expedite fees, and $0.10 million idle labor
single_points_of_failure: WMS central instance; automated sortation at FL-2, GA-1, TX-1, OH-1

business_process: Reseller commerce platform and order APIs (SL-1)
description: Self-service catalog, contract pricing, quoting, ordering, cloud subscription provisioning, and invoices for about 38,000 users; about 430 reseller API integrations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 31% of order lines; 99.9% monthly availability commitment to resellers (SL-1); cloud subscription provisioning is expected in near real time
manual_workaround: Resellers order by EDI or through the sales desk; subscription orders queue
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; payment processor; cloud subscription publishers
quantified_impact_basis: About 30% of platform orders lost to competitors ($0.13 million gross profit), service credits to API resellers, and sales desk overtime
single_points_of_failure: Single production region with warm standby

description: Inbound purchase orders and outbound acknowledgments, advance ship notices, and invoices with resellers and suppliers (about 1.1 million documents a month)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 46% of order lines and most supplier purchase orders; large resellers charge compliance penalties for late advance ship notices
manual_workaround: VANs queue documents; critical partners send orders by email for manual entry
dependent_third_parties: Primary VAN (72% of documents); secondary VAN (28%)
quantified_impact_basis: About $0.20 million lost gross profit and about $0.15 million reseller compliance chargebacks
acquisition_dependency: AQ-1 EDI runs through the site-to-site VPN

business_process: Federal order fulfillment and contract compliance
description: DoD order capture, Section 889 screening, authorized-source sourcing, delivery, and reporting (SPRS, DIBNet, Section 889, contracting officer notices)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DFARS 252.204-7012(c) report due within 72 hours of discovery and FAR 52.204-25(d) report within 1 business day, even during an outage; DoD delivery schedules; covered equipment must never ship
manual_workaround: Hold all federal order releases; screening by the Director, Government Contracts from the offline covered-manufacturer list; DIBNet reporting from the offline laptop with a medium assurance certificate
dependent_people_or_facilities: Federal Solutions contracts and operations staff (about 260)
quantified_impact_basis: About $2.1 million federal revenue per shipping day deferred; about $0.06 million lost gross profit; late-delivery remedies; regulatory impact dominates

description: Staging and configuring network and video equipment for DoD installations in the FSCE and the FL-2 configuration lab (about 30 jobs a month)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Job schedules allow several days; CUI may be restored only inside the FSCE, never to commercial systems
manual_workaround: No workaround for CUI work; notify primes and contracting officers of schedule impact
dependent_people_or_facilities: Federal Solutions engineers (about 90); configuration lab at FL-2
quantified_impact_basis: About $0.24 million configuration revenue per day deferred; schedule penalties

description: Purchase orders to OEMs and authorized distributors, automated reorder release (AI-001), and the open-market sourcing desk
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inventory covers about 34 days of demand on average; allocated items need daily ordering
manual_workaround: OEM order portals for allocated items; ERP reorder reports instead of AI-001 suggestions
dependent_third_parties: OEM vendor programs; forecasting platform vendor; brokers
quantified_impact_basis: Stockouts on fast-moving SKUs from day 2 onward; missed OEM promotional pricing

business_process: Receiving, product authentication, and inventory control
description: Receiving about 9,000 inbound lines a day, OEM serial validation, Product Authentication Lab inspections, cycle counts, and quarantine
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Dock congestion and carrier detention after a day; pressure to skip authentication during an outage raises counterfeit risk
manual_workaround: Receive to quarantine only; no putaway of open-market or suspect lots until systems return; paper receiving logs
dependent_third_parties: OEM serial validation services; inbound carriers
quantified_impact_basis: Carrier detention fees ($0.09 million) and stock unavailable for sale ($0.16 million gross profit)
acquisition_dependency: TX-2 receives on the legacy WMS
single_points_of_failure: Product Authentication Lab at FL-2 (single lab)

description: Rating, carrier selection, labels, manifests, and tracking through the TMS and carrier integrations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No labels means no parcel shipments; carrier cutoffs
manual_workaround: Carrier web portals and thermal printers for priority shipments (about 15% of normal volume)
dependent_third_parties: TMS SaaS vendor; parcel and LTL carriers
quantified_impact_basis: About 85% of parcels miss cutoffs: lost gross profit and expedite fees
single_points_of_failure: TMS vendor (DEP-10); top parcel carrier carries 58% of parcels

description: Imaging and configuration for enterprise customers; ITAD collection, sanitization, certificates of sanitization, and resale (about 310,000 devices a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers need sanitization certificates that match their asset lists; a wrong certificate is a confidentiality failure for the customer
manual_workaround: Hold devices in secure cages; no sanitization without the system of record
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; sanitization software vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Services staff at FL-2 and TX-1 (about 950)
quantified_impact_basis: About $0.6 million services revenue per day deferred; contract credits
single_points_of_failure: Sanitization record database (single instance with standby)

business_process: Credit, invoicing, cash application, and collections
description: Reseller credit limits (AI-003), invoicing, lockbox and card receipts, collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $19.2 million of invoices per shipping day; credit holds stop order release if credit checks are unavailable
manual_workaround: Manual credit overrides by credit managers for top 500 accounts; invoices batch later
quantified_impact_basis: Deferred cash (about $19.2 million a day) and financing cost; manual credit decisions

description: Payment runs to OEMs and suppliers, bank-detail changes, treasury
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: OEMs place accounts on credit hold if payments are late beyond terms
manual_workaround: Treasury releases priority wires through the bank portal with dual approval
quantified_impact_basis: Lost early-payment discounts and OEM credit holds after day 3

description: Monthly and quarterly close, consolidation, and SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines tighten the MTD to 48 hours in the quarter-end window
manual_workaround: Close from last ERP extracts; filing extensions only on counsel advice
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime; regulatory exposure if a filing deadline is missed
acquisition_dependency: AQ-1 ledgers consolidated from the legacy ERP

business_process: Payroll and HR, including temporary worker onboarding
description: Payroll, time capture, onboarding and terminations, staffing agency worker access
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll dates; peak-season onboarding of temporary workers
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll; paper timesheets; temporary workers badge-only until accounts can be created
quantified_impact_basis: Penalties and overtime; peak-season staffing shortfall

business_process: Customer service, returns (RMA), and technical support
description: Order status, returns authorizations, warranty and technical support
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reseller expectations for same-day responses; returns can include suspect counterfeit product
manual_workaround: Contact center uses the order status export; returns received to quarantine
quantified_impact_basis: Contact center overtime and service credits

business_process: Import and customs entry for the private-label line
description: Purchase orders to contract manufacturers, customs entries through the licensed customs broker, CTPAT security records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Containers wait at port; demurrage after free time
manual_workaround: Customs broker files from emailed commercial invoices
dependent_third_parties: Customs broker; ocean and drayage carriers

business_process: AQ-1 order-to-cash at TX-2 (legacy ERP and WMS)
description: Orders, picking, and shipping for AQ-1 customers until cutover (2027-03-31)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same commercial drivers as BP-01 and BP-02 for about $1.16 million of revenue per shipping day
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists; enterprise sales desk takes priority AQ-1 orders
dependent_third_parties: Legacy ERP and WMS support vendor
quantified_impact_basis: About $0.05 million lost gross profit and $0.07 million overtime; real RPO is 24 hours (nightly local backups) against a 15-minute target
single_points_of_failure: Legacy ERP and WMS servers at TX-2; nightly local backups only
